mission_07: You have implemented task embeddings, a powerful abstraction for representing and comparing learning tasks. By encoding task characteristics into fixed-dimensional vectors, you can perform operations like similarity computation, clustering, and model selection. The statistical embedding approach (class means, variances, global statistics) is simple but effective at capturing the essential structure of a classification task. Task embeddings enable automated meta-learning systems that can: (1) group similar tasks for efficient multi-task training, (2) retrieve relevant source tasks for transfer learning, (3) select the best pre-trained model for a new task, and (4) predict the difficulty of a new task. More sophisticated approaches learn task embeddings end-to-end using neural networks, but the statistical approach you implemented is a strong baseline that works well in practice.
